name: sakshya360
description: Smart Real-Time Monitoring & Inspection app for DoSJE schemes (SIH PS 26095)

scripts.infra:up: HOST_LAN_IP=${HOST_LAN_IP:-$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 2>/dev/null || echo 127.0.0.1)} docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait
scripts.ml:setup: cd services/ml && uv venv --python 3.11 .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -r requirements-dev.txt && .venv/bin/python download_models.py && .venv/bin/python train.py
scripts.setup: npm --prefix services/api install && npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix apps/mobile install && npm run ml:setup
scripts.test: npm --prefix services/api test && cd services/ml && .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests
